resolution_method: registry manifest request against registry-1.docker.io; the digest is the Docker-Content-Digest header returned for the recorded tag

SENTINEL_SHIELD_DEPENDENCY_CHECK_IMAGE.rationale: Dependency-Check publishes only a moving `latest` tag, so a readable tag default meant every adopter executed whatever the tag pointed at that day. The digest below is the one behind `latest` on the recorded date and is the same digest the v0.1.26/v0.1.27/v0.1.30 consumer evidence runs used — it is validated, not merely current.

SENTINEL_SHIELD_SEMGREP_IMAGE.rationale: An immutable, explicitly versioned upstream tag. Templates keep the readable form for legibility; production pins the digest recorded here.

SENTINEL_SHIELD_GITLEAKS_IMAGE.rationale: Versioned upstream tag; digest recorded for the production override.

SENTINEL_SHIELD_GRYPE_IMAGE.rationale: Versioned upstream tag; digest recorded for the production override.

SENTINEL_SHIELD_DOCKLE_IMAGE.rationale: Versioned upstream tag; digest recorded for the production override.
